about_the_game:
Are you ready to take over the podcasting world?

In The Podcaster, you step into the shoes of a rising content creator. Manage your schedule, build and customize your dream studio, and prepare your deck of topic cards to spark unforgettable conversations with your guests.

📅 Manage Your Schedule
Plan interviews, choose the best time slots, and avoid conflicts to grow your audience.

🏗️ Build the Perfect Studio
Upgrade your equipment, redecorate your space, and unlock new options that directly impact the quality of your show.

🃏 Topic Cards
Collect, build, and play cards with a wide range of themes to drive engaging and dynamic interviews. Each card can change the course of the conversation!

💬 Unique Interviews
Guests with distinct personalities will react differently to your choices. Explore branching dialogues and uncover surprising moments.

📈 Grow Your Channel
Gain followers, land sponsorships, and climb your way to the top of the podcasting charts.

Be strategic, creative, and charismatic. The Podcaster is the ultimate simulation for anyone who's ever dreamed of holding the mic.

Just... be careful not to get canceled.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 ou AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
